description: This file defines the ContainerLoader class responsible for loading, starting, and unloading container components within the OFBiz framework. It manages container lifecycle, interacts with container configurations, and coordinates container startup and shutdown sequences.

classes.name: ContainerLoader
classes.description: A class that manages loading, starting, and stopping container components for the OFBiz platform, ensuring proper lifecycle management and component initialization.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and initializes containers based on configuration and command-line arguments, including mandatory and component-defined containers, then starts them.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Shuts down all loaded containers in reverse order, handling exceptions during container stop.
